resources.string: Save layouts to the SD card
Copies all layouts to the touchmap folder on EASYROMS. They stay there when you install a new image, and you can share them.
Load layouts from the SD card
Adds the layouts from the touchmap folder on EASYROMS. An app that already has a layout keeps its own.
New layouts: %1$d\nApps that kept their own layout: %2$d\nFiles that couldn\'t be used: %3$d
EASYROMS isn\'t there. Check the SD card, then try again.
There are no layouts to save yet.
No layouts found. Put .json files in the touchmap folder on EASYROMS, then try again.
